page.layout: One page of text; a bracketed list of city names at left-centre (set as lines beside a brace); no marginal notes; catchword "In" at lower right.

main_text.head: Nomina Vrbium Mulieris generis, propria, Stätte Namen Exempla.

l.i: A. Roma, Vinetia, Padoua, Verona, Fiorenza.

main_text.l: Definunt in E. Auignone, Cartagine, Atene,
O. Corinto, Sefto, Abido, Effefo, Argo, &c.

p.i: Nomina Muliebris generis appellatiua, Numeri singul. Terminant In.

main_text.p: Namen Exempel, die AppellativNamen genennt werden In.
In A. Anima, Seel, Amicitia, Freundschafft, Donna, Fraw, Signora, Herrin, Herrliche Fraw.
In E. Opinione, vt & Openione, Meinung, Lertione, Lesung, Affettione, Liebsneigung.
In O. Mano, die Hand, La Mano.
Arma, Waffen, Lode, Lob, Fronde, Blatt am Baum.

page.notes: Printed page number "56" appears as a decorated numeral at top left. Bracket of city names is set as a brace in the original; rendered as lines. Long s rendered as s. Running head absent. Some lines are faint or show-through; readings of "Herrliche", "Oneftà" and "Frode, la Frode" are as legible on scan.
